Ippen.fact: In his itinerant ministry, Ippen combined the devotional recitation of the nembutsu with ecstatic dancing, and the distribution of ofuda (talismans) inscribed with the name of Amitābha, which he handed to people as symbols of faith and rebirth in the pure land of Sukhavati.
